scope: Browser-only baseline preview smoke for non-active surfaces

evidence: GitHub commit status Vercel success targets deploymentId
PR Vercel bot comment maps deploymentId to previewUrl
authenticated Chrome loaded all preview routes without redirect

methodology.browser: Authenticated Chrome profile via browser automation
methodology.interaction: Read-only navigation plus local textarea type-and-keyboard-clear; no submit, send, upload, or DB action
methodology.screenshots: One exact 1440x1000 or 390x844 CDP viewport-clipped PNG per matrix row at scrollY=0.
methodology.controlFilter: Rendered enabled interactive targets only; hidden/noninteractive elements, duplicated inputs enclosed by labels, SVG/icon internals, and controls with an enclosing effective hit target are excluded.
methodology.clippingFilter: CSS overflow alone is not a finding. Only visible interactive targets crossing the viewport or an overflow clip boundary count as impact; noninteractive text/decorative/icon truncation is excluded and preserved in raw metrics.

resultSemantics.pass: No failures, observations, or unresolved items.
resultSemantics.pass_with_observations: No hard failure; genuine non-blocking observations remain.
resultSemantics.unresolved: No proven product failure, but captured error provenance is unresolved.
resultSemantics.fail: At least one mechanically proven product hard failure.

reconciliation.reason: The final initiator-aware matrix reproduced the OPTIONS / 400 and attributed every captured instance to https://vercel.live/_next-live/feedback/feedback.js. It is preserved as preview-toolbar evidence and is not a product failure.
